title: D-045 A1 wave 1b: R3+R4 series height/setback draft rule families (explicitly-enumerated variants; pilot pattern of numeric caps + typed A2 gaps)
objective: Extract, as draft (needs_review) rule families in the existing rules engine/DSL, the CURRENT effective height & setback regulations for the R3 and R4 series districts. Unlike the B-023-blocked R1/R2 packet, the governing sections enumerate these variants EXPLICITLY (the M4-T012 producer's live source verification of 2026-09-13: ZR 23-421 lists R3A, R3X, R3-1, R3-2, R4, R4-1, R4A; 23-422 lists R3-2, R4, R4B) - the authoritative variant list and every value still come ONLY from hash-guarded official snapshots captured in-task. Clone the accepted M4-T006 R5-pilot pattern exactly: separate typed min/max constraints per variant (perimeter wall / ridge caps under the pitched-roof section; base/building height, street wall, setback under the flat alternative where the source provides them); sloping-plane setback geometry and any street-width-conditional provision are recorded as typed, provenance-carrying A2 gaps (D-045-R008 defers the mechanics), exactly as the pilot's r5a_height treatment; where a variant appears in only one of the two sections (e.g. R4B flat-only), encode exactly what the source says and record the asymmetry with its anchor - never symmetrize by assumption. Fail-closed everywhere; needs_review DRAFT; never a buildable-envelope label.
business_reason: D-045-R001 A1 coverage continues on the families whose enumeration the official text settles explicitly, keeping the campaign moving while B-023 (the R1/R2 group-label ruling) waits on the qualified human.

acceptance_scenarios.input: the official ZR text snapshots for the R3- and R4-series height/setback sections
acceptance_scenarios.expected: every variant the official source defines (authoritative enumeration recorded with its source anchor in the source-capture report) gets its OWN scoped constraints; every constraint value carries exact ZR section/clause, amendment/effective date, and snapshot id+hash; no value exists without a snapshot the hash guard verifies

base height, building height, street wall, setback, and perimeter-wall constraints are SEPARATE typed constraints preserving min AND max where the source distinguishes them (never collapsed into one number); units explicit; the DSL schema unchanged unless a genuinely new shape required an additive-only extension justified in the report

acceptance_scenarios.input: a section the source leaves ambiguous or a variant/condition the wave does not cover
acceptance_scenarios.expected: a typed, provenance-carrying gap outcome (never a guessed or interpolated number, never a silent omission); districts outside R3/R4 series evaluate as not-covered by these rulesets; tests prove both behaviors

acceptance_scenarios.input: the NC pattern from the R5 pilot applied to this family
acceptance_scenarios.expected: wrong-district inputs match nothing; cross-variant isolation proven (an R3A value never leaks into R3X, and a 23-422 flat-alternative value never leaks into a 23-421 pitched constraint); superseded/older text is not used (effective-date discipline tested); mutation-style checks show each constraint's test actually binds its value

acceptance_scenarios.input: grep + status fields over the new rulesets and any rendered strings
acceptance_scenarios.expected: every rule is status needs_review (DRAFT); no output or test labels anything a buildable envelope / feasible building / massing / compliance determination; D-045-R009 preserved verbatim (G6 remains the only path past needs_review)

acceptance_scenarios.input: the full rules suite + engine determinism checks + modularity + CI on the pushed head
acceptance_scenarios.expected: ALL existing rules tests pass unchanged; the engine is untouched (forbidden); evaluation is deterministic across runs; python tools/modularity_check.py --check EXIT 0; the api CI job green at the frozen candidate

sloping-plane setback geometry (23-421) and any street-width-conditional provision are A2 territory - typed provenance-carrying gaps ONLY, exactly like the pilot r5a_height treatment (D-045-R008)
variant/section asymmetry (e.g. R4B in 23-422 only) must be encoded exactly as sourced with the anchor recorded - never symmetrized by assumption
cross-variant leakage remains the chief modeling hazard - per-variant scoping with isolation tests mandatory

amendment currency: the extraction must state WHICH text version each snapshot captures and its effective date; a superseded value with a newer amendment in force is a defect
